title: Cross Site Request Forgery in multiple components in Apache JSPWIKI on the specified versions on all platforms allows…
description: A Cross Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability exists in multiple components of Apache JSPWIKI across specified versions on all platforms. This flaw allows an attacker to bypass CSRF protections under certain conditions and HTTP methods. Users are advised to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which addresses this issue.
